english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a serious, sincere attitude or earnest effort and intent.

exampleSentences.english: They are always earnest about their work, so I feel comfortable leaving it to them.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢做嘢一向認真，交畀佢我放心。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 jat1 hoeng3 jing6 zan1 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 ngo5 fong3 sam1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone who carries out work conscientiously and diligently.

exampleSentences.english: I’m always conscientious about my homework and never hand it in carelessly.

english.note: Use 認真 when the emphasis is on conscientious, diligent performance rather than minute detail.

exampleSentences.english: I was painstaking in preparing this report, and my boss praised me.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我做呢份報告做得好認真，老闆都讚我。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zou6 dak1 hou2 jing6 zan1 lou5 baan2 dou1 zaan3 ngo5
